derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040sse.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. TY2025 Schedule SE is a single Part I computation (the old Section A/B split is gone from the fillable). Line 7's maximum ($176,100) is PRE-PRINTED on the form text; its widget f1_13 is a degenerate 1pt-wide sliver and is deliberately NOT mapped. Line 8a and line 13 amounts sit in the MID column (x 410.4-481.65: Line8a_ReadOrder f1_14, f1_22); all other amounts are in the right column (x 504-576), each matched to its printed label row. The minister/Form 4361 checkbox c1_1 is not mapped.
